info.name: DummyJSON API Testing
info.description:
## Purpose

This collection contains functional API tests for the DummyJSON REST API using Postman.

The scope covers:

- product retrieval and search
    
- pagination and query parameters
    
- positive and negative product scenarios
    
- product create, update, and delete operations
    
- user authentication
    
- valid, missing, and invalid access token scenarios
    
- automated post-response assertions
    

Environment variables are used for reusable configuration and authentication data.

## Important Note

DummyJSON simulates create, update, and delete operations. Write operations return representative responses but changes are not persisted on the server.

The collection is intended as a hands-on API testing portfolio project demonstrating REST API testing, Postman scripting, environment variables, authentication testing, and repeatable collection runs.

item.name: 01 - Products - Read

request.description:
Retrieves a single product by ID.

Validates a successful response for an existing product, including the expected product ID, required fields, and selected data types.

Requests a product using an ID that does not exist.

Validates that the API returns `404 Not Found` and an appropriate error message instead of product data.

Retrieves products using `limit` and `skip` query parameters.

Validates the number of returned products and verifies that pagination metadata matches the requested values.

item.description:
## 01 - Products - Read

Covers read-only product API scenarios, including:

- retrieving a single product
    
- handling a nonexistent product
    
- retrieving product lists
    
- limiting results
    
- pagination using `limit` and `skip`
    
- product search
    
- search with no matching results
    

Includes positive and negative checks for response status, data structure, pagination values, and error handling.

item.name: 02 - Products - Write

request.description:
Simulates creating a new product using POST.

Validates the creation status, generated product ID, and consistency between the request body and returned product data.

DummyJSON does not persist the created resource.

item.description:
## 02 - Products - Write

Covers simulated product write operations:

- create product using POST
    
- partial update using PATCH
    
- update using PUT
    
- delete using DELETE
    

Assertions verify HTTP status codes, resource identifiers, updated values, preserved data, and deletion confirmation.

DummyJSON simulates these operations and does not persist changes.

item.name: 03 - Authentication

request.description:
Authenticates a test user using environment-based credentials.

Validates successful login and stores the returned access token in the active Postman environment for subsequent authenticated requests.

Retrieves the currently authenticated user's data using a bearer access token.

Validates successful authenticated access and confirms that the returned user matches the test account used during login.

Attempts to access the authenticated user endpoint without authentication credentials.

Validates that the request is rejected with `401 Unauthorized` and that protected user data is not returned.

item.name: Get authenticated user with invalid token

item.description:
## 03 - Authentication

Covers authentication scenarios using DummyJSON test credentials and bearer tokens.

Includes:

- successful login
    
- access to authenticated user data with a valid access token
    
- request without an access token
    
- request with an invalid token
    

The login request stores the returned access token in the active Postman environment for use in authenticated requests.
